notes: This bounded contract covers the first public RTI-owned HLAmanager.HLAfederate object-management route in the non-installable embedded profile: active ordinary and immutable-point-filtered regional subscription discovery, reliable reflection of all seven required Table 8 initial values, event-driven reflections of the nine predefined switch attributes and four bounded temporal-state attributes after their successful service transitions, accepted time-advance requests/grants, or accepted HLAsetSwitches subset, plus the save/restore lifecycle projection of HLAfederateState (ActiveFederate=1, FederateSaveInProgress=3, FederateRestoreInProgress=5) at the corresponding callback boundaries. The execution-scoped HLAmanager.HLAfederation object additionally projects HLAfederatesInFederation from the live membership map, with direct current-value requests and Join/Resign conditional reflections. Known-object Request Attribute Value Update covers the complete initial and bounded conditional projections plus direct values for the MIM-periodic HLAlogicalTime, HLAlookahead, HLAGALT, HLALITS, HLATSOlength, HLAupdatesSent, HLAobjectInstancesThatCanBeDeleted, HLAobjectInstancesUpdated, HLAobjectInstancesRegistered, HLAobjectInstancesDeleted, HLAobjectInstancesRemoved, HLAobjectInstancesDiscovered, HLAobjectInstancesReflected, HLAreflectionsReceived, HLAinteractionsSent, HLAdirectedInteractionsSent, HLAinteractionsReceived, and HLAdirectedInteractionsReceived attributes, as required even before a periodic timer is configured; ordinary-object local-delete rediscovery and resignation removal are covered. HLAinteractionsSent counts accepted sender-side Send Interaction service invocations once at the service boundary, including ordinary, directed, timestamped, and regional forms; HLAdirectedInteractionsSent is the directed subset. HLAinteractionsReceived and HLAdirectedInteractionsReceived count accepted application Receive Interaction callbacks once at the receiver callback boundary, excluding RTI-originated MOM traffic and suppressed callbacks. HLAobjectInstancesReflected counts distinct application object instances at that same accepted Reflect Attribute Values callback boundary, while HLAreflectionsReceived counts callback invocations; repeated reflections of one object increase only the total, and timestamped queued reflections use the same boundary. The bounded HLAsetTiming interaction now accepts the official HLAfederateReference/HLAseconds pair, arms or disables a target joined-federate deadline, and emits the catalog-defined periodic subset through the normal active-subscription reflection planner. HLA_EVOKED remains caller-gated at an Evoke boundary; HLA_IMMEDIATE now has an embedded per-ambassador scheduler that invokes the same callback route without an Evoke call. The implementation keeps the real filesystem-backed report path and Join-scoped module-designator list as standards-facing values and uses the default-invalid FederateHandle only as an explicitly documented local policy for RTI-originated callbacks. It also has two bounded public MOM request/report pairs, HLArequestObjectInstancesUpdated to HLAreportObjectInstancesUpdated and HLArequestObjectInstancesThatCanBeDeleted to HLAreportObjectInstancesThatCanBeDeleted, with class-grouped nested counts and callback-gated delivery. It does not claim the remaining periodic/other conditional attributes, optional/inherited non-initial attributes beyond this bounded state projection, RTI-owned MOM discovery counting, the other public MOM request/report families, a resolved standard producer mapping, JUnit/protected review, remote transport, or conformance.
